handoff: Approve on HEAD 81faeee92 (after the merge of main): tick record carries sync + timing (observe phases with call counts, decide, act, after, result.ms incl. claim.renew), tick.end/norn tick name the slowest phase, story list and cockpit show the last tick's duration; fields optional, outside facts/action; heartbeat stays readable by older norn. test#4 green. 2 findings, 0 blocking (process probes share local/stories; base_fetch/norn_refs phases not asserted).

findings.title: Process probes and per-story git share the `local`/`stories` phases
findings.detail:
The spec asks for 'per-story git, runner, process' broken down; process liveness probes run inside `local` and `stories`. Documented in docs/recipes.md 'Explain a slow tick'.
Axis: spec
Suggestion: Split them only if a slow tick ever points at `stories`.

findings.title: base_fetch and sync.norn_refs phases not asserted
findings.detail:
The integration test asserts worktrees, local, sync.issues, sync.stories and stories, but not the base fetch or fetchNornRefs phases the spec names.
Axis: spec
Suggestion: Add them to the arrayContaining list when the harness has a git remote.
